categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of high-end titanium and titanium alloy materials, including titanium alloy bars, forgings, and components. Its products are mainly applied in high-end equipment fields such as aerospace, aviation, ships, and weaponry. The company also extends its product line to downstream components, focusing on marine and civilian aviation markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced metallurgical and manufacturing technologies including titanium alloy melting, forging (free forging), precision forging, and heat treatment. It has developed proprietary technologies for controlling chemical composition uniformity, microstructure, and mechanical properties of large-scale titanium alloy ingots and forgings. Key innovations include directional solidification control, high-strength and high-toughness titanium alloys, and manufacturing of large-diameter bars and forgings with uniform properties.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major national aerospace and defense groups such as Aviation Industry Corporation of China, China Aero Engine Corporation, China Shipbuilding Industry Corporation, and China North Industries Group. The company serves high-end aerospace, aviation, marine, and weaponry sectors, providing critical materials for new aircraft, engines, ships, and defense equipment. It also targets civilian aviation and marine equipment markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with its headquarters and production facilities located in Changde Economic and Technological Development Zone, Hunan Province. Its sales and customer base are mainly domestic, serving national strategic industries. International market expansion is ongoing but currently limited.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream and midstream in the titanium alloy supply chain, producing raw and semi-finished titanium alloy materials such as sponge titanium, titanium alloy ingots, bars, and forgings. It also manufactures some downstream components but mainly focuses on supplying materials to aerospace and defense equipment manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company focuses on serving national strategic needs by developing high-performance titanium alloys for aerospace and defense. R&D priorities include high-temperature titanium alloys, high-strength and toughness alloys, low-cost alloys, and corrosion-resistant materials. The company invests heavily in innovation platforms, patent development, and industry standards formulation, aiming to enhance product performance and expand applications in aerospace, marine, and civilian aviation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of titanium and titanium alloy products, including bars, forgings, and components. Sales are mostly contract-based with long-term supply agreements following rigorous qualification and certification processes with key customers. The company does not rely on subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the leading domestic producers of high-end titanium alloys, competing mainly with Western Superconducting Technologies (688122.SH) and Baoji Titanium Industry Co., Ltd. (600456.SH). It holds approximately 7.9% market share in the domestic aerospace titanium alloy market. The industry is concentrated with high entry barriers due to technical complexity and capital intensity.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 808 million, a 0.91% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 152 million, up 3.04%. Total assets reached RMB 3.37 billion, growing 27.24%, and shareholders' equity increased 43.55% to RMB 2.44 billion. The company successfully completed its IPO on the Shanghai Stock Exchange STAR Market in November 2024, raising significant capital to support growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its strong R&D capabilities, proprietary core technologies, and high-quality production processes to deliver titanium alloys with superior uniformity, purity, and mechanical properties tailored for critical aerospace and defense applications. Its products support national strategic equipment upgrades and offer differentiated performance such as high strength-toughness matching and large-scale forging capabilities. The company also highlights its comprehensive certifications and stable long-term customer relationships as competitive advantages.
